report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Rancho Robles MWC

sources_described: Ground Water: CAREY AVE WELL (001_001), UPPER WELL (002_002), WELL 03 (003_003), located off Paseo Robles Ave. in Morgan Hill. Drinking water source assessment available upon request.

extraction_notes: State SWS CCR template, 8 pages. Table 6 (unregulated contaminants), Table 7 (violations) and Table 9 (groundwater TT violations) are printed 'None'. Lead appears twice: Table 2 tap 90th percentile (1.40 ppb, range ND - 2.80) and a Table 4 row (1.40 ppb, range 1.30 - 1.50); both kept with id 'lead' and the Table 4 row flagged in value_basis. 'Level Detected' values with a range (three wells) are not labelled as averages. Page 8 carries the required nitrate health language because the Carey Avenue Well exceeded 5 mg/L as N in 2025 (no MCL exceedance). Lead service line inventory: no lead service lines.
